main.bio:
Hi, I’m Kidus — a Software Engineering student at Addis Ababa Science and Technology University (AASTU) and a full-stack developer focused on building modern, scalable web and mobile applications.

My core strength is front-end development using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, combined with backend experience in Node.js, Express, Django, and Laravel. I’ve built real-world projects including dashboards, responsive web platforms, and mobile applications using React Native and Firebase.

I also bring strong problem-solving skills from A2SV (Africa to Silicon Valley), where I’ve solved 300+ algorithmic problems and worked with advanced data structures and algorithms.

I’ve earned certifications in Front-End Engineering (ALX) and completed full-stack development tracks through GDSC AASTU, where I ranked Top 5 in a competitive hackathon.

I enjoy turning ideas into clean, functional, and scalable products while continuously improving my skills as a software engineer.
